name: ScorpionAI Multi-Criteria Decision Analysis (MCDA) Baseline
status: Immutable Approved Scientific Baseline (Locked at commit a36050a)

normalization_functions.mic: Log10 min-max scaling (lower is better, mapped to 0..1)
normalization_functions.instability_index: Linear piecewise score (cutoff 40: <=40 stable = 1.0, >40 penalized to 0.0)
normalization_functions.net_charge: Physiological net charge mapped to ideal cationic window (+2 to +7)

safety_exclusion_rationale: Hemolysis (w_hemo = 0.00) is excluded from the ranking equation because human RBC HC50 is documented for only 3 out of 20 candidates. Assigning a zero weight avoids penalizing unmeasured candidates or fabricating safety estimates, but MUST NEVER be interpreted as evidence of candidate non-toxicity.
eri_independence_principle: The Evidence Readiness Index (ERI) is calculated independently across 5 objective evidence dimensions and does NOT influence the M1 ranking score.
